tools.name: get_club_starter_guidance
tools.description: Retrieves advisory EDGA model templates, constitutional clauses, and administrative checklists for establishing a volunteer-led disc golf club in England. The tool prompts for or accepts customisation variables (such as club_name, adoption_date, and welfare_officer) to generate ready-to-adopt Word (

tools.name: get_course_development_framework
tools.description: Retrieves advisory EDGA course planning guidance with source links, evidence dates and verification limits. Numerical buffers, budgets and case-study claims require local verification; they are not an authoritative safety standard.

tools.name: get_edga_tour
tools.description: Retrieves official EDGA Tour schedules, stage dates, divisions, season highlights, and real-time division standings from Tjing, strictly restricted to configured EDGA Tour competitions.

tools.name: search_courses
tools.description: Searches public course records supplied live by the independent DiscGolfAPI service. EDGA does not own or control these records. Matches recorded course names and localities, or finds courses nearest to supplied coordinates.

tools.name: list_governance_policies
tools.description: List all official EDGA governance policies, codes of conduct, and standards, including their slug, title, status (Current, Draft), review date, statutory basis, and web URL.

tools.name: get_governance_policy
tools.description: Retrieve the full text, metadata, statutory basis, status, download URLs (PDF/DOCX), and sections of a specific EDGA governance policy or standard.
